summary: @GovTutor Yes the Cunnigham and Stanovich study is great but it's based on year's old data. A: Phonics is in #CCSS K-5 classroom, B: Fundations has to have over 50% penetration, C: I agree guided reading groups and most workshop methods not too helpful

body_html: @GovTutor Yes the Cunnigham and Stanovich study is great but it's based on year's old data. A: Phonics is in #CCSS K-5 classroom, B: Fundations has to have over 50% penetration, C: I agree guided reading groups and most workshop methods not too helpful
